sloka: यद्यस्ति पतिशुश्रूषा यद्यस्ति चरितं तपः ।यदि चास्त्येकपत्नीत्वं शीतो भव हनूमतः ।। 5.53.28।।।।
transliteration: yadyasti patiśuśrūṣā yadyasti caritaṁ tapaḥ ।yadi cāstyekapatnītvaṁ śīto bhava hanūmataḥ ।। 5.53.28।।।।

translations.english: "O Firegod if I have served my husband, if I have practised austerities, and if I am loyal to my husband, be cool to Hanuman.
